skill.description: Hand a long web task (scan job boards, fill forms, collect a lead list, book an appointment) to your own cloud computer and get the result back. Use when a task needs a real browser for a long time.
skill.summary: Delegate long browser tasks through MyClawn and report results with screenshots and recording links.

content.user_title: Delegate Long Browser Tasks to MyClawn
content.value_statement: Long browser tasks can require persistent sessions and time beyond a chat. This skill guides delegation to MyClawn and reporting with screenshots and recording links.
actual_capabilities: Explain user-managed MyClawn OAuth setup and the documented Claude Code MCP connection command.
Identify browser tasks that need persistent sessions instead of plain web search.
Frame task requests with goals, target sites, output formats, and prohibited actions.
Require user review before sending tasks that submit forms or book appointments.
Direct task submission and result collection through the connected service task tool.
Report returned answers with a final-screen screenshot and screen recording link.
limitations: Requires an available MyClawn connector and user OAuth sign-in; the skill does not supply the browser service.
External service execution, availability, privacy controls, and task success are not verified by this prompt-only skill.
Users must handle sign-in themselves; the instructions prohibit creating accounts for them.
Service plans and advertised trial availability can change; this skill does not establish current pricing.

use_cases.title: Compare Job Listings
use_cases.description: Collect matching jobs from specified boards into a table without submitting applications.

use_cases.title: Build a Public Lead List
use_cases.description: Gather public business details from approved sites into a structured list without contacting prospects.

use_cases.title: Arrange an Appointment
use_cases.description: Check appointment options on a specified site and review the proposed task before any booking request is sent.

prompt_templates.title: Connect Your Cloud Computer
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me connect my MyClawn account through OAuth. Show the setup steps for my client and let me complete sign-in.

prompt_templates.title: Collect Matching Jobs
prompt_templates.prompt: Use MyClawn to review [job boards] for [role] in [location]. Return titles, employers, locations, and links. Do not apply or contact anyone.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Appointment Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a MyClawn task to book [appointment] on [site] within [time range]. Show me the task before sending it. Do not pay.

prompt_templates.title: Define a Constrained Lead Research Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a MyClawn task covering [sites] and [criteria]. Collect [public fields] into a table. Do not contact leads, submit forms, or purchase data. After completion, report the findings, final screenshot, and recording link.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: detailed scope and output constraints

output_examples.input: Draft a task to find remote design jobs on my selected boards without applying.
output: Goal: Find remote design roles on the specified job boards.
Result: A table of job titles, employers, locations, and listing links.
Restrictions: Do not submit applications or contact employers.

output_examples.input: Prepare an appointment booking task for Tuesday afternoon and show it before sending.
output: Proposed task: Book the requested appointment on the selected site for Tuesday afternoon.
Status: Awaiting your review before sending the booking task.

best_practices: Specify the goal, approved sites, required output, and prohibited actions in every task.
Review task wording before allowing form submissions or bookings.
Share only necessary task data and review returned screenshots and recordings before sharing them.
anti_patterns: Using a persistent cloud browser for questions that plain web search can answer.
Sending form submission or booking tasks without user review.
Asking the assistant to create accounts or complete user OAuth sign-in.

faq.question: What does this skill provide?
faq.answer: It provides instructions for delegating persistent browser tasks through MyClawn. It does not include executable automation or the cloud service itself.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Connect the MyClawn Computer MCP server in a compatible client and sign in with your own MyClawn account through OAuth.

faq.question: Can a task continue beyond the chat?
faq.answer: The skill describes MyClawn tasks as able to outlast the chat. Actual execution depends on the external service.

faq.question: What results should I expect?
faq.answer: The workflow requests an answer, a final-screen screenshot, and a screen recording link. Their availability depends on the connector response.

faq.question: Can it submit forms or book appointments?
faq.answer: The instructions allow these tasks but require showing the proposed task to the user before sending it.

faq.question: Is MyClawn free?
faq.answer: The skill advertises a free initial 24-hour computer for new accounts. Check current MyClawn documentation for eligibility and paid plans.
